text:
sara.curation: kickoff for the onboard sprint — quick sync. we need owners for ingest, license checks, perf profiles, and a canary plan for the catalog launch. who can own each?

tom.infra: I can own infra-side rollout + canary infra. current reserved pools can handle two small models concurrently but not three; need a burst request. pls tag models that need dedicated capacity. :+1:

leah.ml: I can do perf profiles and embedding shape tests. quick note — some models return variable-length embeddings; we should standardize to 1024-d padding where feasible to keep batch kernels happy.

raj.legal: license quick summary: model-zet and open-sparrow are LGPL-like, good for serving but need attribution; model-aurora has a research-use-only clause — cannot serve. I’ll update the intake sheet with final gating flags by EOD.

sara.curation: thanks raj. leah — can you surface which models use variable embeddings? I’ll pause any with RUO or incompatible licenses.

leah.ml: quick list from staging tests: model-zet (1024 ok), open-sparrow (var 512-2048), aurora (RUO). For open-sparrow I can add a reshape step but it will add ~1.6ms per request for small batches.

mike.engineering: I’ll pick up CR review for the ingest pipeline changes (PR #432). pinging @tom.infra for infra creds in the PR. I can review today if CI passes.

oncall-bot: deploy scheduled: catalog-staging v0.19 -> staging at 3178901300, reminder 15m before.

tom.infra: @mike.engineering i added a short-lived role for the PR tests, creds in the PR description. for canary capacity, propose: 1) small canary (5% traffic) on hosted, 2) dedicated smoke pool for perf verification. any objections?

leah.ml: fine with that. can we get quantized variants for open-sparrow? quant helps perf but needs compatibility check.

mike.engineering: no objections. I’ll add a checklist to the PR: license flag, embedding shape adapter, perf profile, quant compat test, canary plan.

raj.legal: will confirm attribution text and whether attribution can be in-app or must be in docs. leaning docs only but i’ll confirm.

sara.curation: milestone rundown: 1) license gate by EOD today (raj) 2) perf profiles + embedding adapters by tomorrow noon (leah) 3) PR review + ingest integration by tomorrow EOD (mike) 4) infra canary setup by tomorrow evening (tom) 5) quick launch readout Friday 10am. I’ll post a checklist in the intake sheet.

leah.ml: noted. I’ll attach simple test command for embedding reshape: ```python
# reshape adapter example
import numpy as np
def pad_embed(e, target=1024):
    if e.shape[0] >= target:
        return e[:target]
    return np.pad(e, (0, target - e.shape[0]))
```

mike.engineering: will run ingest smoke with that adapter in a local canary before PR merge.

tom.infra: i’ll provision the dedicated smoke pool once the license gate is green. if any model hits RUO, it won’t be provisioned.

sara.curation: perfect. small ask — if anyone hits blockers, drop them in this thread and tag me. otherwise i’ll update the intake sheet and send the calendar invite for the readout. :calendar:
